name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: Small coloured discs marked with letters travel along two circular orbits around a central Hub circle, the inner ring spinning faster and the opposite way from the outer.
use: A product wants a looping diagram of tools or steps circling a central hub.
avoid: Content must stay still or readable; the markers are small and never stop moving.
a11y: The orbit spins forever with no reduced-motion check, and there is no label explaining what the diagram shows. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark panel with a tiny circle labelled Hub at the centre and two thin faint ring outlines around it. On the rings sit small round chips, three on the inner and four on the outer, each in a different bright colour with a white letter.
behaves: The chips glide smoothly around the rings without pause, the inner ones clockwise and quicker, the outer ones the other way and slower. Nothing is clickable; the motion runs on its own.
customise: Drop the markers in as children and set radius, duration, speed, reverse, iconSize and whether the orbit path draws; the keyframes are injected by the component.
weight: light: A few small absolutely positioned discs moved by one shared CSS keyframe animation.
demo: Seven coloured circles labelled A to G orbiting a centre circle marked Hub.
polishWhy: Even spacing and crisp coloured markers; the rings and letters are small on a dark stage.
usage:
"use client" import { OrbitingCircles } from "@/components/ui/orbiting-circles" export default function Demo() { return (
{/* Inner orbit: faster, reverse direction */} A B C {/* Outer orbit: slower, forward */} D E F G {/* Hub */} Hub
) }
